pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Combobox with a listbox popup (list autocomplete). The single-line field is role=combobox with aria-expanded; the textarea keeps its native textbox role (ARIA does not allow combobox on textarea) and exposes aria-autocomplete, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant.

aria.value: help text, counter, error, and the trigger hint ('Type @ for people to mention.')
true while an error is shown
true while the provider is loading

keyboard.action: Opens suggestions for the text typed after it.
Inserts the active suggestion as a mention followed by a space.
Closes the suggestions until the caret leaves this trigger.
Ends the query; the suggestions close.
Native text editing; mentions the edit touches become plain text.

focus: Focus stays in the field; suggestions are referenced with aria-activedescendant, and pointer selection does not move focus.
notes: Result counts, 'No matches', failures, and inserted mentions are announced through a polite live region (4.1.3).
The trigger hint is part of the description, so screen-reader users learn that @ or # open suggestions.
Mentions are plain text in the field; the structure lives in the value.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Some screen readers announce aria-activedescendant changes on a textarea less reliably than on a combobox; the polite count announcement compensates.
